review_description: The sales and quote were excellent.The installer were really polite and did a wonderful job in 38 degree heat.Future eng customer service was amazing. Everything was organised thru them.

Future Energy Australia made a well informed presentation, with meaningful discussion of the shade issues, and evaluation of system size based on estimated day-time usage to be displaced by solar generation, being mindful of poor in feed tariffs for surplus generation. Also addressed potential upgrade requirements with our older switchboard. System install was prompt and orderly, completed in a single day, with compliance & safety certificate signed off in a day or two.However, paperwork errors and omissions means we are still unable to register our solar system with Origin Energy to gain in feed payments, and the installer is un contactable and may have gone out of business.
